godot:
# Untested in Godot.
# The Gradient interpolates linearly between its points (interpolation_mode is left at its default).
# fill_from and fill_to are the CSS gradient line of 37.5deg in a box with aspect ratio 1:1 (width:height).
var gradient := Gradient.new()
gradient.offsets = PackedFloat32Array([0.0, 0.5, 1.0])
gradient.colors = PackedColorArray([Color8(255, 85, 0), Color8(0, 85, 255), Color8(0, 255, 85)])

var texture := GradientTexture2D.new()
texture.gradient = gradient
texture.fill = GradientTexture2D.FILL_LINEAR
texture.fill_from = Vector2(0.07322, 1.05619)
texture.fill_to = Vector2(0.92678, -0.05619)
texture.width = 256
texture.height = 256

                android:endY="-5.619">
                <item android:offset="0" android:color="#FFFF5500" />
